ShortDescription.Value: Cheat and sandbox panel: money, milestones, demand, Force Build and more.

Publish.LongDescription:
### **CityForge Reborn:**
A cheat and sandbox panel, rebuilt from scratch. Click the ◆ button in the top-left corner to open it.
**About & Disclaimer**
This is a brand-new mod inspired by the original CityForge. It is not made by, or connected to, the original author, and it contains none of the original's code. Everything was rewritten from the ground up.
Github link & forum link are both attached to the right. Please send bugs, feedback, and open any issues you may encounter to either. Pull requests are always welcome. Thank you!
CityForge Reborn is fully open source under the GPL-3.0 license, and it will always stay that way.
**Economy**
* Add or remove money, or infinite money * Jump to any milestone, or unlock them all * Development tree points
**Build**
* Instant construction, or ½× to 4× build speed * Level up buildings, max efficiency * Fill storage, or keep it full * Unlimited water and electricity * No pollution
**People**
* Boost move-ins and tourists (up to 10×) * Max happiness, rich citizens, max education * Unemployed exodus: remove jobless households by education level, a share at a time, and see exactly who goes first
**Demand**
* Set demand for each zone * Force Build: buildings spawn even with no demand or a poor lot
**Extras**
* Hotkey to open the panel (Ctrl+Shift+C by default, set your own) * Buff bar: an icon for every cheat that is on; click one to switch it * Pin cheats to the buff bar for one-click toggling * Panel colors * Reset cheats on load * Keep achievements on (set it in the main menu), with a live status in the Settings tab
**Roadmap** (No particular order)
* Translations (support for multiple languages) * Time of day and weather control * Instant garbage, crime and fire cleanup * Unlimited healthcare and education capacity * Max land value * Free building upkeep * Traffic tools: remove stuck vehicles, no accidents * Disasters on/off * Save and load cheat presets * Smoother instant construction on big builds

ChangeLog.Value: New: Unemployed exodus in the People tab, requested by nilesism. Removes households where no one has a job and no adult is in college, filtered by education level. Apply it to a share of the matches (1-100%, 50% by default), picked at random. See who matches first: a breakdown per education level and a list of households with Show and Remove. The game's own clean-up frees their homes, cars, bikes, pets and school places. New: the Settings tab shows whether achievements are really active. Changed: clearer description for Keep achievements enabled; the game still warns that mods turn achievements off even when CityForge has them on.
